rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a crime or criminal incident.

example.english: The police say this crime is still unsolved.
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 waa6 ni1 zung1 zeoi6 on3 mei6 po3

rows.note: Choose this formal term when focusing on the criminal act itself rather than the case or incident.

example.english: The defendant must take responsibility for the crime they committed.
example.traditional: 被告要為自己犯下嘅罪行負責。
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 jiu3 wai6 zi6 gei2 faan6 haa6 ge3 zeoi6 hang4 fu6 zaak3

rows.note: Use this for crime in general, especially criminality as a social problem rather than one particular incident.

example.english: To reduce crime, education and family support are both important.
example.traditional: 要減少犯罪，教育同家庭都好重要。
example.jyutping: jiu3 gaam2 siu2 faan6 zeoi6 gaau3 juk6 tung4 gaa1 ting4 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3
